rules.title: No superlative standing in for a number
rules.text: Adjectives with no measurement behind them read as marketing, and this repository's docs are read as evidence. If there is a number, use the number; if there is not, say what was observed.

judgement.question: Is this an unmeasured claim of quality — an adjective doing the work that a number, a command or an observation should do?

criteria.true: the word asserts quality, speed or ease with nothing on the line measuring it
criteria.false: the line backs the claim with a number, a command or a named observation, or the word is inside a quotation attributed to a source
